products.name: Transfer, C.
products.description: Titanium rotational analog TOE Material: Ti6Al4V Fit for ROOTT C, ROOTT CS, ROOTT B and ROOTT BS product lines. Developed around one-piece implants and simple handling that avoids any inflammations or negative developments through aesthetic options. TOE is rotational titanium transfer for external platform, which is used to take a highly precise impression with a close-tray from multiple implants Precisely show the place and direction of the implantCan be used in combinations with plastic transfers Aesthetically contrasting green colorScannable
products.description_html:
Titanium rotational analog TOE Material: Ti6Al4V Fit for ROOTT C, ROOTT CS, ROOTT B and ROOTT BS product lines. Developed around one-piece implants and simple handling that avoids any inflammations or negative developments through aesthetic options. TOE is rotational titanium transfer for external platform, which is used to take a highly precise impression with a close-tray from multiple implants 

  • Precisely show the place and direction of the implant
  • Can be used in combinations with plastic transfers 
  • Aesthetically contrasting green color
  • Scannable

products.description: Titanium telescopic cap TCE Material: Ti6Al4VFit for ROOTT C, ROOTT CS, ROOTT B and ROOTT BS product lines. It is developed around one-piece implants and simple handling that avoids any inflammations or negative developments through aesthetic options. TCE is titanium made telescopic cap of reverse conus, which allows to deepen the edges of a dental prosthetic into the gum and enables the possibility of taking the prosthetics off without damaging them when needed.Retention without cement or screwEasy but strong telescopic fixationComfortable for the patientCost-effective

  • Comfortable for the patient
  • Cost-effective

products.description_html:
Short titanium telescopic cap TCES Material: Ti6Al4V

Fit for ROOTT C, ROOTT CS, ROOTT B and ROOTT BS product lines. It is developed around one-piece implants and simple handling that avoids any inflammations or negative developments through aesthetic options. TCES is short titanium made telescopic cap of reverse conus, which allows to deepen the edges of a dental prosthetic into the gum and enables the possibility to take the prosthetics off without damaging them when needed.

  • Retention without cement or screw
  • Easy but strong telescopic fixation
  • For implants shortened to 5mm
  • Comfortable for the patient
  • Cost-effective

products.description:
Implant Analog for Narrow platform ROOTT R , NS- line Multiunit Recreates the implant position in the Lab: It sits inside a
master dental model (poured stone or 3D-printed) to represent the exact spatial
position and orientation of the implant in the patient's jawbone. Dental
technicians use it to design, fit, and build custom abutments, crowns, bridges,
or full-arch bars. How It Is Used in Workflows
 Conventional
 (Stone) Workflow: An impression coping captures the implant position
 in the patient's mouth. The analog is attached to the coping inside the
 set impression before dental stone is poured around it.
 Digital
 (Printed) Workflow: An intraoral scan data file places a virtual
 analog into a 3D model design. The physical analog is then pressed or
 screwed into a designated holder in an additively manufactured
 (3D-printed) modelReverse Scanning: (Reverse Scan Body / Technique protocol) is an advanced digital method used to capture the exact position of dental implants by scanning the patient's existing temporary prosthesis outside the mouth
products.description_html:
Implant Analog for Narrow platform ROOTT R , NS- line Multiunit 

Recreates the implant position in the Lab: It sits inside a master dental model (poured stone or 3D-printed) to represent the exact spatial position and orientation of the implant in the patient's jawbone. Dental technicians use it to design, fit, and build custom abutments, crowns, bridges, or full-arch bars.

How It Is Used in Workflows

  • Conventional (Stone) Workflow: An impression coping captures the implant position in the patient's mouth. The analog is attached to the coping inside the set impression before dental stone is poured around it.
  • Digital (Printed) Workflow: An intraoral scan data file places a virtual analog into a 3D model design. The physical analog is then pressed or screwed into a designated holder in an additively manufactured (3D-printed) model
  • Reverse Scanning: (Reverse Scan Body / Technique protocol) is an advanced digital method used to capture the exact position of dental implants by scanning the patient's existing temporary prosthesis outside the mouth

products.name: Transfer cap, R.
products.description: TC with Plastic Cap Fixation SystemThe TC offers a precise and efficient solution for dental implant procedures, combining ease of use with accurate results. Its plastic cap fixation system provides impression accuracy comparable to open tray techniques while maintaining the simplicity and convenience of a closed tray system.High Precision: The TC's design ensures an accurate cast, allowing for precise transfer of implant positioning.Anti-Rotation Slot: The semicircular cutout is perfectly aligned with the anti-rotation slot, ensuring a secure fit and reliable impression transfer.Space-Saving Design: The innovative design allows for multiple transfer caps to be placed in close proximity, making it ideal for procedures in narrow spaces.Choose TC with Plastic Cap Fixation for a reliable, accurate, and streamlined dental implant workflow.
products.description_html:
TC with Plastic Cap Fixation System


The TC offers a precise and efficient solution for dental implant procedures, combining ease of use with accurate results. Its plastic cap fixation system provides impression accuracy comparable to open tray techniques while maintaining the simplicity and convenience of a closed tray system.


High Precision: The TC's design ensures an accurate cast, allowing for precise transfer of implant positioning.

Anti-Rotation Slot: The semicircular cutout is perfectly aligned with the anti-rotation slot, ensuring a secure fit and reliable impression transfer.

Space-Saving Design: The innovative design allows for multiple transfer caps to be placed in close proximity, making it ideal for procedures in narrow spaces.

Choose TC with Plastic Cap Fixation for a reliable, accurate, and streamlined dental implant workflow.

products.name: Transfer, open tray, R.
products.description: Open Tray Transfer TO Material: Ti6Al4V ROOTT R is based on a two-piece dental implant with self-tapping thread for maximum prosthetic options for most common and necessary cases with all tools needed. Open-tray transfer TO has a conical connection with hex, allowing transfer to the exact position of the implant into the model. Easy to use because of a contrasting green color. The screw can be tightened by hand manually to reduce micro-movementsThe surface is polished and anodized with bright green colourHigh retention interface with impression materialReduces the effect of the implant angulation
